title: alophia intermedia
intro: Alophia intermedia, commonly known as Desert Marigold or Desert Marigold Yarrow, is a flowering plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating fever, colds, and respiratory issues, as well as its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Alophia intermedia include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve menstrual cramps, and soothe skin irritations, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents in Alophia intermedia are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been used to treat a range of health conditions, making it a valuable plant in herbal medicine.
